lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the WARNING about missing sudo/firewall tooling: added sudo, iptables, ipset, dnsutils, curl to the apt-get install block, and added a scoped sudoers drop-in (/etc/sudoers.d/bun-firewall) granting the bun user NOPASSWD access to exactly '/bin/bash /workspace/.devcontainer/init-firewall.sh'. Next story US-R1-003 needs to fix the doc/ADR inconsistency: the ADR and recovery-runbook.md incorrectly refer to the container user as 'cam-worker' (uid 1001) when the Dockerfile uses USER bun (uid 1000). Fix docs/adr/0003-worker-isolation-boundary-dev-container.md and docs/recovery-runbook.md to say 'bun' instead of 'cam-worker'.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: 'bun ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/bash /workspace/.devcontainer/init-firewall.sh' is valid sudoers syntax. When arguments are specified, the user may only run that exact command+arguments. sudo bash <path> resolves bash to /bin/bash before matching rules, so the entry correctly gates the postStartCommand.
